purpose: Authoritative market-family coverage contract for the combined Thunderpick sports + esports production scanner.

coverageStatusRules.OK: required family collected and inventory/comparison counts are internally consistent
coverageStatusRules.NO_MARKETS_AVAILABLE: collector succeeded and explicitly verified no current markets exist
coverageStatusRules.DEGRADED: one or more expected independent sources failed, rate-limited, geo-blocked, or returned anomalously low inventory
coverageStatusRules.COVERAGE_FAILURE: required family was not collected, not enumerated, or cannot distinguish zero opportunities from zero collection

hardRequirements: Deep-enumerate Thunderpick inventory before outside matching.
Preserve exact contract identity through normalization.
Explicitly enumerate map handicap rather than relying only on generic spread normalization.
Explicitly enumerate esports kills/deaths and other player props with OVER/UNDER identity.
Report source degradation such as HTTP 429 or geo-blocks.
Every hourly report must distinguish zero qualifying opportunities from zero markets collected.
